quarterly_data.quarter: Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (10-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: focusing on humanoid robots, robot dogs and other emerging uses, in H1 2026 it completed development of a series of special cables - joint-motor power cables, radar communication cables and coreless-motor cables for dexterous hands - which are now in small-batch production; further progress depends on industry development, end demand and customer projects. Timing of its single-lane 448G high-speed cable depends on customers' technical plans and project schedules.
